claims.quote: Pathogenic variants in STXBP1 are among the major genetic causes of neurodevelopmental disorders.
Epilepsy was absent in 18/71 (25%) of individuals.
Twenty-nine of 61 individuals (48%) were able to walk unassisted
24/69 (35%) were able to speak single words.

claims.object_text: lower GMFCS scores in individuals without epilepsy
claims.quote: Individuals without epilepsy presented with a similar onset and spectrum of phenotypic features but had lower GMFCS scores (median 3 vs 4, p < 0.01) than individuals with epilepsy.

claims.object_text: less likely to walk unassisted with epileptic spasms
claims.quote: Individuals with epileptic spasms were less likely to walk unassisted than individuals with other seizure types (6% vs 58%, p < 0.01).

claims.object_text: higher speech impairment scores with early epilepsy onset
claims.quote: Individuals with early epilepsy onset had higher speech impairment scores (p = 0.02) than individuals with later epilepsy onset.
